annotation.title_clean: NYPD Rulemaking: Permitting Process for Take-off and Landing of Unmanned Aircraft (Drones) – Public Comments on Proposed Chapter 24 of Title 38 RCNY
annotation.title_en: NYPD Rulemaking: Permitting Process for Take-off and Landing of Unmanned Aircraft (Drones) – Public Comments on Proposed Chapter 24 of Title 38 RCNY
annotation.authors_or_issuer: New York City Police Department (NYPD) / NYC Rules portal
annotation.summary_en: Public-comment page for the NYPD's 2023 rulemaking adding Chapter 24 to Title 38 RCNY, creating a permit for drone take-off and landing in NYC. It compiles over a hundred comments, mostly from operators objecting to the 30-day notice, $150 fee, insurance and notification requirements and arguing FAA preemption and Remote ID make the rules redundant.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed permit required to launch or land unmanned aircraft in NYC, with limited exceptions
Application at least 30 days in advance with a non-refundable $150 fee
Applicants must provide insurance proof, data privacy policy and cybersecurity incident reporting
Notice to community boards and public posting required before operation
Commenters argue FAA preemption, Remote ID and LAANC make the rules redundant, and request exemptions for schools, model clubs and first responders
